data.title: Rent arrears letter from the property management
data.summary: Hausverwaltung Beispieldach & Partner informs the tenant that €340.00 of the November 2026 rent is still outstanding and that the €186.42 top-up payment from the 2025 operating cost statement has not been paid either. The total of €526.42 is requested by 7 December 2026.
data.explanation: Your property manager says part of November's rent plus a service-charge (Betriebskosten) top-up from 2025 are unpaid, totalling €526.42. Please transfer this amount by 7 December 2026 to avoid further steps. If you cannot pay in full, the letter invites you to contact them about a payment plan (Ratenvereinbarung) — doing this before the deadline is advisable. No legal remedy instructions are given in this letter; if you dispute the amounts, it may help to check your rent account and the 2025 operating cost statement, or seek advice from a tenants' association.

items.title: Pay the outstanding rent and operating-cost arrears
items.action: Transfer the total outstanding amount of €526.42 to the landlord's rent account by the due date, or contact the property management about a payment plan if you cannot pay in full.
items.quote: Wir bitten Sie, den Rückstand bis 7. Dezember 2026 zu überweisen.
